pages.title: Doping Furnace
pages.text: A furnace where a dopant soaks into a wafer, a few atoms in a million, and makes it a semiconductor.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the dopant dose and the diffusion time. The carriers per cubic centimetre must make a working junction (10¹⁶ to 10¹⁸); more and it conducts like a metal.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Doped Wafer.
